Arceus is building an AI-native law firm and is hiring a Founding Product Engineer to build its legal-work platform. The role owns core product features across the stack, collaborates with attorneys and AI engineers to turn legal workflows into software, and helps shape engineering practices as the team grows.
Computer Software
Responsibilities
Build and own core product features across the stack, from data models to the interfaces attorneys and clients use every day
Partner closely with AI engineers and attorneys to turn legal workflows and review playbooks into reliable software
Make pragmatic architecture and tooling decisions that let us move fast now without painting us into a corner later
Own quality: write maintainable code, build for reliability, and take responsibility for what you ship in production
Help define engineering culture, standards, and hiring as the team grows
Move work over the finish line when it matters — customer experience always comes first
Qualification
Full-Stack Development
TypeScript
React
Relational Databases
AI/LLM Development
Required
You're a product-focused builder who ships
You don't just close tickets — you have a point of view on what should get built and why, and you sweat the details of the user's experience
You've owned features end to end, made pragmatic calls under pressure, and you care about the craft without letting perfect block done
You think like an entrepreneur and operate like an owner
You move fast and want your work in front of real users quickly
You take complete ownership of outcomes and find a way to deliver
You bring urgency and intensity to your work every day
You take pride in going above and beyond what is expected
You constantly look for ways to move faster, raise the quality bar, and become more consistent in how you execute
You are resilient when things don't work and persistent enough to find another way
1-3 years building and shipping production software, ideally at an early-stage company, or as a founder at your own company
You have strong product instincts and full-stack ability (e.g., TypeScript/React on the front end, a modern backend stack, relational databases)
You have built something with AI/LLMs, either in a job or on your own
You have a track record of owning features end to end and making sound engineering trade-offs
You are comfortable with ambiguity and worked in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment
You have excellent judgment and communication, and a high bar for your own work
Benefits
Competitive equity in the company
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
Catered lunches and dinners at the office
Wellness and learning stipends
Option to contribute to a 401(k)
Unlimited PTO
